question: What qualities characterize the sacred place or stream known as Digvāsā?
premises: It has issued forth as a sacred flow.
It is famous by the name Digvāsā.
inference: The place or stream known as Digvāsā is famous, has issued forth, and destroys all sins.
uncertainties: Whether digvāsā refers to a stream or a site is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: Issued forth and destroying all sins, it is famous by the name Digvāsā.
